information.description:
Arasaka's standard frontline soldier, well trained and milspec equipped, often leading squads of Guards or Rangers. Soldiers in numbers means something big.

Arasaka: The Japanese megacorp's security arm, from lobby guards to cyberninjas.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Arasaka Soldier: EQ + SGL; Expends 3 rounds in a burst in Single Shot. Whenever this burst would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP. Only expends 6 rounds in Autofire.

Every shot is a 3-round burst; it won't fire with fewer than 3 left. Ablates 1 extra SP (2, or 3 with Armor-Piercing).
